note: Code-only/conceptual course policy: Programming Foundations for Salesforce teaches general programming concepts (variables, data types, control flow, functions, basic object-oriented thinking) as a primer before the dedicated Apex course later in this path. Teaching happens entirely through code blocks and Apex-flavored pseudocode, never screenshots, per this course's documented screenshot policy. This specific lesson is a conceptual introduction to programming itself (algorithm vs. code, why Apex-flavored examples are used) and makes no claim about a specific Salesforce feature, API, or UI that would require a citation.
